milestones.title: Milestone 1: wallet inspection
milestones.description: Balance, SPL token holdings and recent activity for any Solana wallet, read live from the blockchain.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: transaction verification
milestones.description: Confirmation status, fee, slot, per-account SOL movements and per-mint token movements for any transaction.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: funding transparency and downloadable reports
milestones.description: On-chain funding wallet summary plus one-click JSON wallet and CSV funding reports.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: dashboard refinements
milestones.description: Mobile-responsive dashboard layout, funding wallet explorer link, lint tooling and published milestones.

milestones.title: Milestone 5: community proposal registry
milestones.description: Public proposal page is live: visitors can submit proposals as GitHub issues and view public discussion and review status. Pull-request submission and automatic promotion into the versioned proposal registry are not implemented yet.

milestones.title: Milestone 6: RPC reliability
milestones.description: Improve RPC reliability through dedicated provider support and response caching so public endpoint rate limits are less likely to degrade the dashboard.
